defects.title: A compound whose name contains another compound's name receives that metabolite
defects.trigger: compounds citrate and isocitrate, param.model.mets = {'cit[e]';'icit[c]'}, metNames = {'Citrate';'Isocitrate'}
defects.observed: summaryConc.avr_A.mets = ["cit[e]"; "cit[e]"]: line 73 uses contains(), so citrate's pass also writes isocitrate's row and isocitrate (no [e] form) never resets it

notes: Repro (after initCobraToolbox(false)): sample=["s1";"s1";"s2";"s2";"s3";"s3";"s4";"s4"]; type=repmat("sample",8,1); compound=repmat(["citrate";"isocitrate"],4,1); concentration=(1:8)'; group=["A";"A";"A";"A";"B";"B";"B";"B"]; perturbation=["ctrl";"ctrl";"drug";"drug";"ctrl";"ctrl";"drug";"drug"]; T=table(sample,type,compound,concentration,group,perturbation); p.model=struct('mets',{{'cit[e]';'icit[c]'}},'metNames',{{'Citrate';'Isocitrate'}}); s=summaryConcentrations(T,p); s.avr_A.mets % ["cit[e]";"cit[e]"]; q.metLookupTable=table({'citrate'},{'cit'},{'cit[e]'},'VariableNames',{'ChemicalName','AlternativeName','Mets'}); summaryConcentrations(T,q) % error line 97. Without mapping the means/SDs are right (avr_A: citrate 1|3, isocitrate 2|4). Also observed (not recorded): with removeOutliers a figure is opened for every group/perturbation even at printLevel 0 (line 130); group/perturbation/compound must be string or categorical columns (== on cellstr fails). No caller in src (row lists none).
confirmed_by: lead (writer's MATLAB reproductions: a lookup table without a model reads the undefined model at line 97; contains() at line 73 maps isocitrate to cit[e])

defects.title: A system without java stops with an undefined variable options
defects.trigger: checkChemoinformaticDependencies() with java not on the system path
defects.observed: Unable to resolve the name 'options.atomMapping'. (line 39; R2025a)
defects.expected: javaInstalled = false and message 'java is not installed'

notes: Reviewer note confirmed. Repro: old = getenv('PATH'); d = tempname; mkdir(d); setenv('PATH', d); checkChemoinformaticDependencies  % prints 'cxcalc is not installed', 'obabel is not installed', then the error at line 39; setenv('PATH', old); rmdir(d). On this machine with the real PATH it returns [0 1 1] (obabel exits 1 from MATLAB because of a library error, which the function counts as installed). Callers atomicallyResolveModel and generateChemicalDatabase reach the defect only on machines without java.
confirmed_by: lead (writer's MATLAB reproduction: without java, line 39 reads the undefined options.atomMapping)

notes: Only the not-installed error is testable: the test sets PATH to an empty temp folder (status 127) and checks the installation message with and without the save argument. Exempt: line 50 (isunix||ispc always true, dead) and lines 58-125 (need Open Babel; obabel from MATLAB fails on a libstdc++ version error here and returns 1, not 127, so without the PATH change the function would go on to parse an error text). Unreached code writes a file 'tmp' in the current folder and never deletes it (not recorded, not executed).

Generated straight-line solver (2690 executable lines), fully covered by one call; inputs are the fixtures of testFitC13Data (point.mat v0, a steady-state flux of model.mat, and convertCarbonInput(expdata.input)), so the test is placed in testFitC13Data next to them (testSolveLin/testIdv2idv for c13solver already live there). Checks MDV lengths/normalisation/nonnegativity, unlabelled input -> [1 0 ...] (independent), agreement with slvrEMU (<1e-10, observed <3e-13) and 4 Tier 5 MDVs. Callee side effects handled in the test: cdv2idv/idv2mdv leave globals CDV2IDVSAV, pseudohash1, pseudohash2 (removed), and solveLin leaves warning MATLAB:nearlySingularMatrix off (it restores only singularMatrix; state restored by the test). Note generateIsotopomerSolver (testFitC13Data) regenerates this src file in place via Perl.
